rule_applied: first ladder rung, in the prespecified order, with max SE(D_Delta) <= 0.010 at every Delta and N >= 100
cycles_between_justification: measured recovery on smoke seeds: |e| after a shift settles within 1 cycle for fresh and RBG and within ~3 for full reuse; 15 cycles of spacing is therefore ample for every policy, and the SAME spacing is used for all
applied_symmetrically: the chosen rung is used for every policy and every shift; replication is never increased for cells close to passing
smoke_outcomes_are_not_evidence: the smoke run necessarily revealed the approximate direction of the result. That cannot bias the confirmatory test: epsilon, the shift set, the policies, the estimator, the statistical unit and the decision rule were all frozen in STAGE_C1_PROTOCOL.md beforehand, so no degree of freedom remained to adjust. The smoke numbers are recorded here as sizing information and are excluded from the Stage C.1 result.
